Q5738.reason: Mixed goods/services contracts fall under the UCC unless the services predominate, and here the laptop is the core purchase so the UCC applies.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires intent to commit a felony at the time of entry, and he entered the open party only to have a good time, forming the intent to steal later.

Q8324.reason: An agitated, drug-seeking presentation fits addiction or withdrawal, where chronic use downregulates post-synaptic dopamine receptors.
